# Haven Station, for the tests
// A test scene, and none of it is the game's story. A file called arrive_<place>.txt plays when the ship, or the
// player alone, arrives at that place: the first time at length, and after that in a line.

== start
? flag arrived_haven -> again
? not captain -> alone

The jump ends the way jumps do, with the stars going still. Then Haven Station comes up on the viewport, with a fee schedule painted on the first wall you can read.

@Ensign Pell Asante: "Berth's assigned, Captain. Dockmaster says the hour's eighteen credits. Then he said it was twenty-two."

* flag arrived_haven
* journal: The Meridian reached Haven Station, and the dockmaster changed the fee while she was docking.

NOTE: [STORY] Haven's stories are in the Leads menu.
END

== alone
Haven Station, on your own, with the noise of the docks coming up through the shuttle's deck plates before the hatch is open.

* flag arrived_haven
* journal: You reached Haven Station alone.

NOTE: [STORY] Haven's stories are in the Leads menu.
END

== again
Haven again. The fee is still whatever the dockmaster says it is.
END
